definition.def: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.
examples: ...an updated version of his book. [+ of]
Ludo is a version of an ancient Indian racing game. [+ of]
The second-hand version is a poor copy of the original.

definition.def: Someone's version of an event is their own description of it, especially when it is different to other people's.
examples: Yesterday afternoon the White House put out a new version of events. [+ of]
She and her friends wanted to go public with their version of the incident.
There have been widely differing versions in the newspapers about the prison siege.
